desc_en: This piece embodies contemporary boldness through a vibrant design. Crafted with attention to detail, it features a regular fit silhouette with a flat lapel collar. Each garment is made especially for you on demand, ensuring exclusivity and a conscious approach to fashion. Available with worldwide shipping.
